meta._instructions: Copy this file to user_data/project_library.json, then edit the projects to be your own. The agent picks 2 projects per job based on tag overlap with the JD, so put real projects with real tags here. Keep at least 3-5 projects so the agent has selection room. Bullets contain LaTeX formatting (\textbf{...} for emphasis), since the output gets injected into example.tex directly.
meta.description: Project library for the resume tailoring agent.
meta.bold_convention: Bold the opening action phrase (verb + object), key technical terms that match common JD keywords, and quantitative metrics.

projects.name: TaskFlow -- Personal Task Management Web App
projects.summary: Full-stack task manager with real-time multi-user collaboration via CRDTs and offline-first sync.
bullets: \textbf{Architected a full-stack task manager} with \textbf{Next.js, Postgres, and Prisma}; designed a normalized schema supporting nested tasks, recurring schedules, and offline sync via \textbf{IndexedDB} and a service worker

\textbf{Built a real-time collaboration layer} using \textbf{CRDTs and websockets}; enabled multiple users to edit the same task list with \textbf{sub-100ms} conflict resolution and live presence indicators
\textbf{Deployed on Vercel} with edge functions; achieved a \textbf{95+ Lighthouse score} across all categories and a \textbf{1.2s Time-to-Interactive} on 4G connections

projects.name: ChatBot Framework -- Open-Source LLM Wrapper Library
projects.summary: Python library wrapping multiple LLM providers behind a unified streaming interface, with tool-use abstractions.
bullets: \textbf{Designed and published a Python library} wrapping multiple LLM providers (\textbf{OpenAI, Anthropic, local Llama}) behind a unified streaming interface; reached \textbf{800+ GitHub stars} within 3 months of release
\textbf{Implemented a tool-use abstraction} with automatic JSON-schema validation, retry-on-malformed-output, and pluggable backends; enabled provider swap with a one-line config change
\textbf{Wrote comprehensive docs and 40+ examples} covering RAG, agents, structured output, and streaming; attracted 12 external contributors and merged 30+ community PRs

projects.name: DistCache -- In-Memory Distributed Cache
projects.summary: Redis-compatible in-memory cache with consistent hashing and Raft-based replication, written in modern C++.
bullets: \textbf{Built a Redis-compatible distributed cache} in \textbf{C++20} with consistent-hashing partitioning across nodes; benchmarked at \textbf{1.2M ops/s} on a 3-node cluster with sub-millisecond p99 read latency
\textbf{Implemented Raft-based replication} for leader election and log-replicated writes across replicas; survived chaos-tested rolling restarts and network partitions with no data loss
\textbf{Optimized the hot read path} using lock-free hash maps, custom slab allocators, and zero-copy network buffers; reduced p50 GET latency from \textbf{120us to 38us}

projects.name: DataFlow -- Configurable ETL Pipeline CLI
projects.summary: YAML-configured ETL pipeline CLI for ad-hoc data work over CSV/Parquet/Postgres sources, built on DuckDB.
bullets: \textbf{Designed a YAML-configured ETL CLI} on top of \textbf{DuckDB}; supported CSV, Parquet, and Postgres sources with declarative joins, filters, and aggregations executed against an in-memory columnar engine

\textbf{Built a typed schema-validation layer} with Pydantic that catches type mismatches and missing columns before pipeline execution; reduced data-quality incidents by \textbf{6x} on a real production workload
\textbf{Added structured run logs} with per-step row counts, runtime, and memory usage written as JSON to S3; integrated with Datadog dashboards for trend monitoring across ~80 daily pipeline runs
